digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage LLM error handling
propositions: Three defensive exception handlers in gate_dispatch and container_stage that route LLM-tier failures to ABORT or DEGRADE have no test coverage, verified by mutation testing.

Plan-review mid-run arm is reachable in production via the batch-step path where batch-runner exceptions propagate raw from run_workflow; code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract with no confirmed in-tree raw raiser.
Container warm-call abort in _run_container is reachable and must handle both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError to abort the fan-out with exactly one model call.

New unit tests must verify both exception types cause degraded INDETERMINATE verdict with gate_error sidecar in plan/code review paths and abort behavior in container warm calls, passing under unmutated code but failing when exception types are narrowed.
